basic_info.description:
This charming, fully renovated two-story home with 4 spacious bedrooms and 2 beautifully updated bathrooms is ready for you to call home. The main level features a bright, open-concept floor plan, with the inviting living room seamlessly flowing into the gorgeous kitchenperfect for relaxing or entertaining guests. The stylishly remodeled kitchen boasts sleek, high-end countertops, modern cabinetry, and premium appliances, making it a dream for both cooking and entertaining.
Both the upper and lower levels offer a versatile layout with two generously sized bedrooms and a well-appointed bathroom on each floor, providing privacy and comfort for everyone. Conveniently located near major freeways (I-280, US 101, and I-80), scenic hills, and the serene Glen Canyon Park, this home offers the perfect balance of city convenience and a peaceful retreat. You'll also be just a short walk away from vibrant local restaurants and cozy cafes, allowing you to experience the best of timeless San Francisco urban charm. This is the ideal home for homeowners looking for a perfect blend of style, comfort, and location, all in one place.
